_source: Star Citizen game files via StarBreaker

resources.name: MolinaMold
resources.description: This aggressive fungus was first discovered growing within faulty air filters installed in Levski. The spores, when inhaled in high enough concentrations, can make Humans fatally ill.

resources.name: Argon
resources.description: Chemically inert under most conditions, argon is an odorless, colorless gas that is as soluble in water as oxygen. Appears lilac in a discharge tube.

resources.name: CarbonDioxide
resources.description: Owing to carbon's ability to form a variety of allotropes with vastly different properties and its sheer abundance in the universe, this element is used in a wide variety of applications.

resources.name: Helium
resources.description: An inert noble gas that is colorless, tasteless, and non-toxic. The second most abundant element in the universe. Produced within stars during the nuclear fusion of hydrogen.

resources.name: Hydrogen
resources.description: The most abundant element in the universe. The building block of stars. Highly flammable in its pure form.

resources.name: Methane
resources.description: A highly flammable gas composed of carbon and hydrogen. It is colorless and odorless in its natural state.

resources.name: Nitrogen
resources.description: A low-density, diatomic gas with no color or odor in its natural state. A necessary element in human respiration.

resources.name: Oxygen
resources.description: The third most abundant element in the universe, oxygen is a highly reactive chalcogen gas that readily forms oxides with other materials.

resources.name: cold
resources.description: Cooler

resources.name: hot
resources.description: Heat

resources.name: LifeSupport
resources.description: Life Support

resources.name: Agricium
resources.description: A rare and valuable silvery metal with a blue-green sheen. Malleable, ductile, and largely non-reactive.

resources.name: Ore_Agricium
resources.description: A rare and valuable silvery metal with a blue-green sheen. Malleable, ductile, and largely non-reactive.

resources.name: Aluminum
resources.description: A chemically reactive, gray metal that is malleable, lightweight, ductile, strong, and resistant to corrosion. Capable of superconductivity.

resources.name: Ore_Aluminum
resources.description: A chemically reactive, gray metal that is malleable, lightweight, ductile, strong, and resistant to corrosion. Capable of superconductivity.

resources.name: Atlassium
resources.description: This very strong metal alloy is often one of the few materials salvageable from severe wreck sites.

resources.name: Borase
resources.description: This highly thermally conductive material is often formed from cosmic ray spallation and is most typically found in younger star systems.

resources.name: Ore_Borase
resources.description: This highly thermally conductive material is often formed from cosmic ray spallation and is most typically found in younger star systems.

resources.name: Copper
resources.description: A soft red-orange colored metal with high conductivity. Prone to oxidation unless properly treated.

resources.name: Ore_Copper
resources.description: A soft red-orange colored metal with high conductivity. Prone to oxidation unless properly treated.

resources.name: Dymantium
resources.description: One of the toughest known metal alloys that can be forged. It is extremely difficult to manufacture and must be used with care in order to avoid accidentally weakening the material during application.

resources.name: Gold
resources.description: A commonly found ductile metal favored for its conductivity. Though it falls in and out of fashion, it is often used for decorative purposes as well.

resources.name: Ore_Gold
resources.description: A commonly found ductile metal favored for its conductivity. Though it falls in and out of fashion, it is often used for decorative purposes as well.

resources.name: Iron
resources.description: Element Fe, strong, malleable, highly susceptible to rust and found in large volume across most star systems.

resources.name: Ore_Iron
resources.description: Element Fe, strong, malleable, highly susceptible to rust and found in large volume across most star systems.

resources.name: Ore_Jaclium
resources.description: A naturally occurring rare metal form of jahlium, it is used in the production of extremely strong alloys with incredible tensile strength. Originally confused with common jahlium when first discovered, the above average results when used lead to researchers to realize its value.

resources.name: Lindinium
resources.description: A versatile metal that has been successfully alloyed with numerous other elements, miners in the Nyx system have been known to go to great lengths to procure it.

resources.name: Ore_Lindinium
resources.description: A versatile metal that has been successfully alloyed with numerous other elements, miners in the Nyx system have been known to go to great lengths to procure this ore.

resources.name: Riccite
resources.description: Found on worlds with heavy seismic activity, this metal is extremely flexible and has some self-healing properties.

resources.name: Ore_Riccite
resources.description: Found on worlds with heavy seismic activity, this metal is extremely flexible and has some self-healing properties.

resources.name: Ore_Saldynium
resources.description: Saldynium

resources.name: Savrilium
resources.description: This metal, first discovered in the Nyx system, was a main economic driver for early miners of the system thanks to its unique alloyed properties.

resources.name: Ore_Savrilium
resources.description: This metal ore, first discovered in the Nyx system, was a main economic driver for early miners of the system thanks to its unique alloyed properties once refined.

resources.name: Steel
resources.description: An alloy of iron and carbon, this ancient material is still in uses thanks to its affordable price and high tensile strength.

resources.name: Stileron
resources.description: This metal is ideally suited to the rigors of physical-based warfare. It is favored by defense manufacturers in armor construction for its ability to take a beating. However, it does not handle distortion well and is notoriously difficult to refine.

resources.name: Ore_Stileron
resources.description: This metal is ideally suited to the rigors of physical-based warfare. It is favored by defense manufacturers in armor construction for its ability to take a beating. However, it does not handle distortion well and is notoriously difficult to refine.

resources.name: Tin
resources.description: Tin is a pliable, soft metal, with a silvery white-blue tint. It is conductive and resistance to corrosion.

resources.name: Ore_Tin
resources.description: Tin is a pliable, soft metal, with a silvery white-blue tint. It is conductive and resistance to corrosion.

resources.name: Titanium
resources.description: This silver-colored chemical element is excellent at producing strong, lightweight alloys.

resources.name: Ore_Titanium
resources.description: This silver-colored chemical element is excellent at producing strong, lightweight alloys.

resources.name: Torite
resources.description: Found throughout the Nyx system, this common metal has been mined by local inhabitants for a variety of uses though it has yet to be adopted wider.

resources.name: Ore_Torite
resources.description: Found throughout the Nyx system, this common metal ore has been mined by local inhabitants for a variety of uses though it has yet to be adopted wider.

resources.name: Tungsten
resources.description: Used in many different alloys, tungsten in its pure form becomes malleable while maintaining its hardness.

resources.name: Ore_Tungsten
resources.description: Used in many different alloys, tungsten in its pure form becomes malleable while maintaining its hardness.

resources.name: Xapyen
resources.description: Only recently used in Human manufacturing, this complex alloy of Xi'an origin is a jack of all trades that is extremely useful in numerous applications.

resources.name: Aphorite
resources.description: Decorative jewel crystal prized for its multi-hued tones.

resources.name: Aslarite
resources.description: Aslarite is a naturally-occurring mineral that is most commonly found on asteroids. Sought for its natural thermal insulation properties, it can be processed and used in the construction of personal armor to help the wearer withstand extreme temperatures.

resources.name: Raw_Aslarite
resources.description: Aslarite is a naturally-occurring mineral that is most commonly found on asteroids. Sought for its natural thermal insulation properties, it can be processed and used in the construction of personal armor to help the wearer withstand extreme temperatures.

resources.name: Beradom
resources.description: Formed when sap from the Beraber Fir is crystalized during forest fires, this transparent deep blue "gemstone" is often polished smooth and used in jewelry. While it can be manufactured by growing trees and then doing a controlled burn, the time investment for the trees to reach the proper maturity still make this a rare commodity.

resources.name: Beryl
resources.description: A mineral that creates natural hexagonal crystals. Colorless in its pure form, its impure forms include the gems emerald and aquamarine.

resources.name: Raw_Beryl
resources.description: A mineral that creates natural hexagonal crystals. Colorless in its pure form, its impure forms include the gems emerald and aquamarine.

resources.name: Bexalite
resources.description: This mineral harvested from worlds with no natural magnetic core, has found widespread use in electrical systems.

resources.name: Raw_Bexalite
resources.description: This mineral harvested from worlds with no natural magnetic core, has found widespread use in electrical systems.

resources.name: Carinite
resources.description: A rare mineral because the extreme pressure needed for its formation is very uncommon, it is in high demand thanks to its use in advanced computer processors and other cutting-edge electronics.

resources.name: CarinitePure
resources.description: Typical carinite sources feature various impurities. However, under certain extremely rare conditions, carinite veins that are more than 90% pure can form. Computing hardware that demands exacting precision will usually seek out pure carinite.

resources.name: Corundum
resources.description: The crystalline form of aluminum oxide. Used as a gem. Varieties include ruby, sapphire, and padparadscha.

resources.name: Raw_Corundum
resources.description: The crystalline form of aluminum oxide. Used as a gem. Varieties include ruby, sapphire, and padparadscha.

resources.name: Diamond
resources.description: An allotrope of the element carbon, diamonds form over billions of years under high heat and pressure. Extremely hard and thermally conductive.

resources.name: Raw_Diamond
resources.description: An allotrope of the element carbon, diamonds form over billions of years under high heat and pressure. Extremely hard and thermally conductive.

resources.name: Dolivine
resources.description: A dull green gemstone that is used decoratively but also can be used for industrial purposes thanks to its resistance to weathering and high density.

resources.name: Feynmaline
resources.description: The paramorphic crystalline structure of this mineral is extremely volatile. When extra energy is introduced, as is typical with modern mining, the ore will often explosively degrade into the more stably structured Janalite. This instability makes Feynamline very dangerous to acquire but also extremely valuable as an industrial anti-matter precursor if it can be properly harvested.

resources.name: Glacosite
resources.description: As glaciers form, heavier mineral contents sink over time and are then crushed by the weight above as the ice deforms and flows. When the glacier recedes, Glacosite deposits are left behind. White and blue in color, the crystals form in long shiny strands that almost are cotton-like in appearance. Glacosite has found specialized commercial use since it is an extremely light and durable insulator.

resources.name: Hadanite
resources.description: A crystal oscillator sought out for its extremely high frequency of vibration which makes it useful in various applications.

resources.name: Hephaestanite
resources.description: Found often near volcanic outcroppings, this mineral is commonly used for a thermal insulator.

resources.name: Raw_Hephaestanite
resources.description: Found often near volcanic outcroppings, this mineral is commonly used for a thermal insulator.

resources.name: InertMaterials
resources.description: Non-valuable materials collected during the mining process.

resources.name: Janalite
resources.description: This rare mineral is valued as an industrial anti-matter precursor. While more stable than other precursors like Feynmaline, it's tougher structure and energy resistance makes it much more difficult to utilize as well as collect.

resources.name: Laranite
resources.description: A somewhat radioactive, crystalline gemstone. Black with streaks of dark red, it can only be used as jewelry if shielded.

resources.name: Raw_Laranite
resources.description: A somewhat radioactive, crystalline gemstone. Black with streaks of dark red, it can only be used as jewelry if shielded.

resources.name: MixedMining
resources.description: A mixed collection of commodities obtained by mining

resources.name: Pressurized_Ice
resources.description: Ice that has been purified and compressed to transparent by restricting natural expansion. This allows for more efficient transport in bulk.

resources.name: Quantanium
resources.description: A highly unstable mineral used in the production of quantum fuel.

resources.name: Raw_Quantainium
resources.description: A highly unstable mineral used in the production of quantum fuel.

resources.name: Quartz
resources.description: A chiral crystal composed of silicon and oxygen that can be found in a wide variety of forms and colors.

resources.name: Raw_Quartz
resources.description: A chiral crystal composed of silicon and oxygen that can be found in a wide variety of forms and colors.

resources.name: Sadaryx
resources.description: A durable crystal, sadaryx is commonly used in the production of industrial focal lenses in laser applications.

resources.name: Taranite
resources.description: Extremely conductive, this mineral was first discovered when a researcher noticed a breed of electrosensitive hermit crab using pieces of it to form its shell.

resources.name: Raw_Taranite
resources.description: Extremely conductive, this mineral was first discovered when a researcher noticed a breed of electrosensitive hermit crab using pieces of it to form its shell.

resources.name: Astatine
resources.description: A dangerously radioactive, highly unstable halogen. Some of its isotopes have half-lives of one second or less.

resources.name: Carbon
resources.description: Owing to carbon's ability to form a variety of allotropes with vastly different properties and its sheer abundance in the universe, this element is used in a wide variety of applications.

resources.name: Chlorine
resources.description: A light gas with a high electron affinity and a yellow-green tone at room temperature. One of the halogens.

resources.name: Flourine
resources.description: A toxic and highly reactive gas that appears pale yellow in its natural state. Very easily forms compounds with almost all other elements.

resources.name: Iodine
resources.description: The heaviest stable halogen. Sublimes from a purple-black metallic solid into a violet gas.

resources.name: Ouratite
resources.description: Notable for its ability to withstand kinetic impacts, ouratite is a solid hydrocarbon that is found only in the Stanton system. Once refined, this rare material can be used as combat armor plating.

resources.name: RawOuratite
resources.description: Notable for its ability to withstand kinetic impacts, ouratite is a solid hydrocarbon that is found only in the Stanton system. Once refined, this rare material can be used as combat armor plating.

resources.name: RawSilicon
resources.description: A strong and brittle element with good thermal conductivity. Crystalizes in a diamond form.

resources.name: Silicon
resources.description: A strong and brittle element with good thermal conductivity. Crystalizes in a diamond form.

resources.name: AgriculturalSupplies
resources.description: Items required for agricultural production. Includes fertilizers, feed, and pesticides.

resources.name: AmioshiPlague
resources.description: Not nearly as ominous as its name, the Amioshi Plague is an invasive lichen that grows in the cracks of rocks. While the core of the lichen burrows out of sight to try and absorb as much moisture as it can find, the part near the surface sprouts hooded scales that eject spores to spread to other rocks. It's relatively short maturation period is the origin of its name.

resources.name: BlueBilva
resources.description:
NDR: 23
HEI: 10
Effects: Hydrating, Energizing

The Blue Bilva is known for its distinctive rich flavor; which is highly astringent, aromatic and very high in fructose. The fruit can also be identified by its slightly pointed, ovoid shape, and dark blue to indigo skin. The fibrous flesh of the bilva clings firmly to its large stone which is so hard that it can only be cracked through mechanical means. It takes about 11 months to ripen on the tree. It is commonly eaten dried or turned into brandy.

resources.name: Armillaria
resources.description: Preferring to spore in the depths of dark caves, the fruiting mushrooms of the Bluemoon fungus are often collected as a highly-valued petroleum-free lubricant used across a wide-variety of industries.

resources.name: Carbonsilk
resources.description: This light, flexible and incredibly strong material is woven from carbon strands collected from the secretions of specially bioengineered worms.

resources.name: CK13SeedBlend
resources.description: These genetically-modified barley seeds were banned because of their aggressive growth and high-levels of cross-pollination that has frequently ravaged any neighboring plant life. However, the plant's high yield and ease of growth have continued to make it a sought-after commodity.

resources.name: Slam_Unprocessed
resources.description: An organically derived terpenoid lipid, dicylasterone (commonly known as DCSR2), has been banned from use in biomedical applications. Currently, it is most typically used in the manufacture of illegal narcotic 'SLAM.'

resources.name: DecariPod
resources.description: A large spore pod harvested from the decari that can be collected and used as a food source. However, the decari pod cannot be consumed directly. It must have its thick out layer and spiny filaments removed, and the fibrous hymenium cooked for a long time before it can be safely digested by Humans.

resources.name: DegnousRoot
resources.description: Degnous root is a macroalgae that was discovered in the shallow coastlines of Prime on Terra. Once harvested, degnous can be utilized as an ingredient in medical and health products thanks to its unique blend of amino acids.

resources.name: QuasiEgg
resources.description: A gourmet egg that is renowned for its complex flavor, it is always in demand from restauranteurs and gourmands alike. The flavor of the egg can vary depending on diet and environment. After the eggs are laid, their shells chemically bond to specialized pouches located on the Quasi grazer's belly, where they are carried until they hatch.

resources.name: Fotia
resources.description: The fotia scrub relies on solar flares for its reproduction. Rather than having traditional stamen and pollen, it allows radiation from flares to mutate its genetics before releasing its seedpod. Some enterprising individuals seek out and collect the seedpods because of their natural radiological properties that can be utilized in various ways.

resources.name: FreshFood
resources.description: Various meats, grains and produce that have not yet been cooked, dried, salted, frozen, pickled, or otherwise preserved.

resources.name: GaspingWeevilEggs
resources.description: The eggs of this small beetle are commonly held to be an aphrodisiac, but when allowed to hatch the weevils themselves will eat through sealants used in space station construction. Transport of the insect or its eggs is banned in the UEE.

resources.name: GoldenMedmon
resources.description:
NDR: 39
HEI: 19
Effects: Energizing, Hydrating

Grown in temperate climates on the Maru Ebony Tree, Golden Medmons are left to fall off the tree when ripe and collected. The fruit at that stage is extremely firm and astringent. They only become edible after being 'bletted' or softened through ethylene ripening.

resources.name: HeartOfTheWoods
resources.description:
NDR: 31
Effects: Toxic

This fungus produces fleshy deep-red caps that grow in a pattern resembling a internal structure of a heart. Found in cold climates, it typically grows on trees and decaying logs. Not yet successfully cultivated commercially, this deep flavored mushroom is prized by epicureans across the 'verse and can fetch a high price in the right markets. It does contain a mild toxin that is destroyed when cooked, so consuming raw should be avoided.

resources.name: HumanFoodBars
resources.description: Despite what the label on the packaging declares, the Banu manufactured "Human Food Bars" have been shown to contain multiple additives deemed unsafe for Human consumption.

resources.name: JumpingLimes
resources.description:
NDR: 09
HEI: 06
Effects: Dehydrating

Grows on a cactus in the deserts of Yar (Centauri II). A local variant that developed naturally after terraformation was complete, the spiny fruit start off purple and turn green when they are ripe.

They acquired their name because of the ease in which they fall off the cactus and attach themselves to clothing and skin, as if they "jumped" there.

The leathery, barbed skin must be peeled back to reveal the juicy flesh of the interior. The taste is sweet, extremely tart and astringent.

Locals warn that if you become lost in the dessert you should be careful using jumping limes for hydration as they can make you feel even more thirsty.

resources.name: KopionHorn
resources.description: The horn of the kopion is made of a unique combination of bone and naturally-occurring carbon nanomaterials. When properly processed, it can be used to aid in bone regeneration with a far greater rate of success than lab-grown materials. This application has made it a valuable commodity.

resources.name: SpiralFruit
resources.description:
NDR: 23
HEI: 10
Effects: Hydrating

The Lunes is a deciduous tree native to the warmer areas of Osha in Kilian system. It bears an edible fruit known as a Lunes fruit or a Spiral Fruit based on the circular ridges that can form once the fruit begins to ripen. The fruit’s skin is covered with a short fuzz that is generally removed before consumption. When ripe, the Lunes is a very sweet and juicy flavor and have become a very popular summer delicacy, commonly found in ice cream and other desserts.

resources.name: MarokPearl
resources.description: The marok has a gizzard, which takes food that has been previously swallowed from the stomach and "chews" it before passing it back into the stomach to be digested. To help this process, the marok's body secretes a substance that hardens into a large crystalline stone that stays in the gizzard and helps food get pulverized more efficiently. The stone has unique conductive properties that make it sought-after for use in computer chips.

resources.name: MoldSample
resources.description: Samples of the deadly Molina Mold securely sealed in biohazard containers to ensure its toxic fungal spores can't get airborne.

resources.name: MoldTreatment
resources.description: A lifesaving treatment for those suffering from exposure to Molina Mold.

resources.name: OrganiMass
resources.description: PH - Organics are formerly living organisms that have been prepared for other purposes. This includes meat, plant and animal parts, biofuel, and other such items.

resources.name: Oza
resources.description:
NDR: 09
HEI: 07
Effects: Hydrating

A hybrid citrus first grown in Croshaw, it's hardiness, ease of transport, and juice yield has seen it rapidly spread across the Empire. It features thick, bumpy dark green skin, bright orange flesh ribbed with heavy pithing, and no seeds. 

Tart, sweet and bitter, the taste of Oza often described as being a combination of all the other citrus types rolled into one fruit. Difficult to peel and fibrous, its pulp is not often eaten. Typically it is split open and sucked on, its flesh being discarded. It is also popularly used in many cocktail recipes.

resources.name: Pingala
resources.description: Every aspect of the pingala follows the golden ratio resulting a visually arresting plant. This include its seeds which are highly sought after by plant collectors. Especially since attempts to cultivate the pingala in greenhouse environments has proven extremely difficult.

resources.name: Pitambu
resources.description:
NDR: 25
HEI: 10
Effects: Hydrating, Hypo-Metabolic, Immune Boosting

The skin of the pitambu is thin and waxy and easily peeled away using its green leaf-like growths. Inside is a is crisp and watery, bright red flesh which is filled with tiny white seeds that have a mild, nutty taste. The flesh and seeds are traditionally consumed together.

resources.name: Prota
resources.description: A resilient slime mold that can form in extremely corrosive environments and pressure, Prota secretes a strong adhesive that can be distilled into a commercial-grade glue.

resources.name: RantaDung
resources.description: A dry cube-shaped dung that comes from a large isopod-like crustacean known as a Ranta. It has recently been discovered that the dung contains a unique bacterial biome that helps the Ranta process and digest minerals and some researches are hopeful will lead to industrial or medical innovations.

resources.name: Raw_Ice
resources.description: Raw Ice can be refined into Hydrogen and Oxygen

resources.name: RevenantPod
resources.description: Contrary to its ominous name, the Revenant is actually a variety of the Altrucia Tree, an indigenous plant of Terra known for its thick and colorful leaves. Geoengineers introduced fields of Altrucias to Hyperion in an effort to break up the dust storms. Although the project failed, the Altrucia trees adapted to the perpetual wind patterns, shedding its leaves and thickening the wood in the trunk. Botanists initially believed that the Altrucias had died, but on closer inspection, discovered that they were quite alive and thus, the name was born.The pods are collected because the pollen is processed and turned into Altruciatoxin.

resources.name: AltruciaToxin_unprocessed
resources.description: The pollen of Revenant Tree (altrucia lacus).

resources.name: SunsetBerry
resources.description:
NDR: 08
HEI: 06
Effect: Toxic

These sunset-hued berries grow best in cold climates. They are toxic and not suitable for Human consumption. Eating them can result in symptoms such as vomiting and extreme cramping. Higher dosages have been known to be fatal. While the raw unprocessed berries are very bitter and tannic, once fermented, the resulting poisonous brew has a very sweet taste and is more commonly known as "Death Wine." Recently, medical researchers are investigating if the toxin in sunset berries could be used to help treat nerve damage or neurological diseases.

resources.name: Vlk_Fang
resources.description: The valakkar continually sheds its teeth throughout its lifetime. As the animal burrows through the sand and catches prey, its teeth are frequently damaged. Once a new tooth finishes forming, it severs the connective tissue that was holding the old tooth in place, causing it to break off and fall to the ground. The fangs of the valakkar can also be extracted from the animal's mouth after its death. Collectors seek out the valakkar fangs for use in crafting various luxury items.

resources.name: YormandiEye
resources.description: Able to thrive in a wide variety of environments, the yormandi has a robust immune system that responds to unknown pathogens at incredible speed. Its eyes contain antibodies that are much sought-after by medical researchers.

resources.name: Electricity
resources.description: Power:

resources.name: AceInterceptorHelmet
resources.description:
Item Type: Racing Helmet
Damage Reduction: 5%
Temp. Rating: -35 / 65 °C
Radiation Protection: 26000 REM
Radiation Scrub Rate: 145.8 REM/s

The unique open-faced design makes the Ace Interceptor helmet a lightweight and liberating option for operating in atmosphere. It features precisely layered plating to protect the head from a variety of combat and environmental hazards and an impact resistant, anti-glare visor over the eyes. Visor is AR crosshair compatible.

resources.name: ProcyonCanister_Damage
resources.description: This composite is a moldable material used in the construction of explosives. In addition to being commonly used in demolition applications for heavy industry and mining, it is also used to create small potent warheads. Care must be taken while transporting larger quantities of the composite as it is impact and heat sensitive.

resources.name: AltruciaToxin
resources.description: Created by chemically processing the pollen of Revenant Tree (altrucia lacus), common effects of ingesting or smoking altruciatoxin include relaxing of the muscles, sensory enhancement, and lethargy. Heavy usage can cause staining of the tongue.

resources.name: ElectronicsEquipment
resources.description: Devices, cabling, and rigging used for multimedia presentations and events.

resources.name: Bioplastic
resources.description: A plastic replacement material created when fossil fuels began running low in Sol. It is derived from renewable biomass sources, often from vat grown bacteria but can be derived from industrial byproducts as well.

resources.name: CadmiumAllinide
resources.description: This refined form of cadmium has great energy potential and is used frequently in reactors and batteries.

resources.name: MilitarySupplies
resources.description: A variety of items assembled to support combat forces, such as ammunition, structural repair tools and clothing.

resources.name: ConstructionMaterials
resources.description: Various supplies used to build, repair, and maintain buildings and structures.

resources.name: ConstructionMaterialScrap
resources.description: Can be processed at refineries into Construction Material.

resources.name: ConstructionMaterialPowder
resources.description: Can be processed at refineries into Construction Material.

resources.name: ConstructionMaterialChunks
resources.description: Can be processed at refineries into Construction Material.

resources.name: Detatrine
resources.description: Refined from the natural toxin found within the rare detatium fruit, this chemical has numerous medical applications.

resources.name: DiamondLaminate
resources.description: One of the hardest manufactured materials today, this glass-like substance is frequently used in the construction of cockpit windows.

resources.name: ProcyonCanister_Quantum
resources.description: An extremely heat resistant epoxy often used in the mounting and repair of ship thrusters. It is considered very difficult to transport in its uncured state as it becomes explosively unstable when exposed to Chan-Eisen fields during quantum travel. Specialized containers must be used to safely transport the epoxy long distances. Once set and cured, the Diluthermex is no longer reactive.

resources.name: DistilledSpirits
resources.description: A purified beverage produced through the distillation of fermented substances. Possesses at least 20 percent of alcohol by volume.

resources.name: Dopple
resources.description: A dissociative drug that creates a strong feeling of separation. People, places, and objects familiar to the user take on a distorted and unreal quality. Some users report a detachment from emotions. Doplencyethorphine is used in small dosages medically to help with extreme emotion issues and rage management problems. Recreational users take it for the effect of resetting the mundane and everyday into something new and different. Side effects include memory loss, panic attacks, paranoia, and psychotic episodes.

resources.name: Dynaflex
resources.description: Developed for use by the military, this absorptive material can withstand severe stress owing to its flexibility.

resources.name: Elespo
resources.description: A brand name of a light sponge-like material that has exceptional electrical absorption properties.

resources.name: Etam
resources.description: Created from the leaves of indigenous plants, E'tam is an organic hallucinogenic drug used by the Xi'an to slow body function and focus in order to achieve a deeper meditative state. For Humans, the effects are much more severe. E'tam causes hyper awareness, cognitive enhancement and improved focus. Users can be so engrossed in tasks that they neglect to eat, sleep or take care of other body functions.

resources.name: Freeze
resources.description: A synthetic tranquilizer used for muscle therapy that causes very heavy sedation in the user while also activating the nerve endings in their muscles. Originally created as a way to rebuild damaged/rebuilt muscle tissue, it found another use as a sedative weight-loss supplement, and when in a concentrated form, as a party drug.

resources.name: Glow
resources.description: A variant of the street drug known as "Neon," Glow is formulated to create more euphoric feelings and less hallucinations than are normally associated with other members of its chemical family. The telltale sign of a user is that swallowing the capsule often leaves glowing residue on the tongue. Some people microdose Glow to help them maintain a more positive attitude (being careful to drip the dose directly onto the back of their throat). The main risk is that once the effect wears off people can become suicidally depressed for a short while before their brain chemistry normalizes.

resources.name: HPMC
resources.description: This liquid hexagonal lattice bonds readily to surfaces when electrically charged, solidifying almost instantaneously to create an incredibly strong and durable polymer mesh that maintains integrity at a range of temperatures and pressures.

resources.name: HLX99Hyperprocessors
resources.description: Commonly known as "Helixes" these Banu manufactured processing chips were designed for fullcore crypto-cracking and are used in the manufacture of computer system infiltration devices.

resources.name: PlasmaFuel
resources.description: Hydrogen that is energized and then used by thrusters to propel vehicles.

resources.name: Lastaprene
resources.description: An advanced synthetic polymer designed with optimal properties for several commercial applications. It has greater viscoelasticity than most commonly produced rubbers.

resources.name: LifeCureMedsticks
resources.description: The use of these imitation CureLife Medpens has resulted in numerous deaths.

resources.name: HolidayBox
resources.description:
A small, wrapped package meant to get you in the Luminalia spirit. Banu merchants celebrating the holiday used to hide small gifts aboard their ship to encourage revelers to explore all their wares. As the holiday grew in popularity within the UEE, Human merchants modified this tradition by hiding empty gift-wrapped packages around a space station or landing zone that could be exchanged for credits if returned unopened. The increased foot traffic into their stores spurned holiday sales and became a tradition in its own right. 

Stow this gift for sentimental value, or sell it at a commodities terminal and spend the credits on a holiday gift for yourself.

resources.name: Lycara
resources.description: A extremely light and strong carbon composite material first developed for racing ship rudders.

resources.name: Mala
resources.description: Digestion of the unique toxins found in the Mala fly causes confusion of the congnitive pathways of the brain and results in synesthesia where different sensory experiences cross and mix. Effects described by users range widely; from being able to see music to tasting colors. Since pain does not register the same way while under the influence of the toxin, many people of have been severely injured while "sense swapping." For example, one user lost their arm after perceiving the heat from a thruster engine as pleasurable.

resources.name: Maze
resources.description: Street name for a tranquilizer and knock-out hallucinogen that's Tevarin in origin. Dosing up is like taking a massive journey into your own mind. To the outside world, you’re nearly comatose, but to you, it’s a wild trip. A handful of religions have been started after a user took a trip into the maze. Aside from the toxic element, there’s a chance you won’t come down from the high. They call this ‘getting disconnected.’ Users stay locked in their own head until their brain decays. Maze was originally used as a near religious experience for Tevarin warriors to find their path in life. Since the fall of the Tevarin empire, it's become corrupted into a purely recreational drug. The Tevarin who once treated this drug with reverence and ritual, now make boatloads of credits selling it to anyone who wants to risk a potentially dangerous trip.

resources.name: MedGel
resources.description: Consumed by medical beds, MedGel provides the key resources needed for cloning and healing.

resources.name: MedicalSupplies
resources.description: A variety of items produced primarily to treat injury or illness.

resources.name: mobyGlassPersonalComputers
resources.description: These knock-off mobiGlas use pirated software and are often infected with spyware and malicious programming.

resources.name: VentFilters
resources.description: Special filters developed by Gyson to replace faulty units and purify the air of Molina Mold spores.

resources.name: Neograph
resources.description: A recently discovered form of graphene, this complicated lattice structure of carbon molecules produces an extremely light and strong material.

resources.name: Neon
resources.description: A psychoactive designer drug known for increased energy, euphoria, and mild hallucinations (particularly how the body processes light). Due to its chemical complexity, it's much more expensive than other street drugs, but is very popular in club culture.

resources.name: Omnapoxy
resources.description: Durable and resistant, this resin quickly sets when applied to form a hardened polymer.

resources.name: OsoianHides
resources.description: The tanned skins from Osoians, a Fair Chance protected species from Oso II.

resources.name: PartyFavors
resources.description: Small items used to help encourage a festive mood. Typically given or sold to celebrants in attendance at an event or party.

resources.name: ProcessedFood
resources.description: A nutritional substance that has been transformed trough physical or chemical means into food.

resources.name: QuantumFuel
resources.description: Fuel used by quantum drives to propel ships at high speeds or, if equipped with a jump module, through jump tunnels to other systems.

resources.name: RMC
resources.description: Recycled Material Composite, commonly referred to as RMC, is the end result of low-tier salvaging where a myriad of alloys and polymers are mixed together during the collection process.

resources.name: RedfinEnergyModulator
resources.description: Made by various Banu manufacturers, this energy modulator is distinct for its red-hued heatsinks. Though it can be installed into most Human component subsystems to reduce power draw, its extremely dangerous fail rate has caused it to be banned for import into the UEE.

resources.name: RS1OdyseySpacesuits
resources.description: These imitation RSI Odyssey undersuits are cheaply made counterfeits that are hazardous to use.

resources.name: Sarilus
resources.description: A material first introduced into Human manufacturing after trade with the Banu. It is extremely distortion resistant. Though Human made Sarilus does a good job, many hold that the Banu manufactured product is superior.

resources.name: ShipAmmunition
resources.description: Refill your ship's ballistic ammunition.

resources.name: ShipAmmoSize1
resources.description: Bulk ammunition servicing size 1 ship weaponry, based on volume.

resources.name: ShipAmmoSize2
resources.description: Bulk ammunition servicing size 2 ship weaponry, based on volume.

resources.name: ShipAmmoSize3
resources.description: Bulk ammunition servicing size 3 ship weaponry, based on volume.

resources.name: ShipAmmoSize4
resources.description: Bulk ammunition servicing size 4 ship weaponry, based on volume.

resources.name: ShipAmmoSize5
resources.description: Bulk ammunition servicing size 5 ship weaponry, based on volume.

resources.name: ShipAmmoSize6
resources.description: Bulk ammunition servicing size 6 ship weaponry, based on volume.

resources.name: ShipAmmoSize7
resources.description: Bulk ammunition servicing size 7 ship weaponry, based on volume.

resources.name: ShipAmmoSize8
resources.description: Bulk ammunition servicing size 8 ship weaponry, based on volume.

resources.name: ShipAmmoSize9
resources.description: Bulk ammunition servicing size 9 ship weaponry, based on volume.

resources.name: ShipCountermeasuresDecoy
resources.description: Flares, decoys and other countermeasure supplies for ships of any size

resources.name: ShipCountermeasuresNoise
resources.description: Noise, chaff and other countermeasure supplies for ships of any size

resources.name: Silnex
resources.description: An advanced silica ceramic developed by early RSI researchers to allow ships to better withstand atmospheric reentry.

resources.name: Slam
resources.description: Most commonly ingested as a gas. Vials of SLAM are cracked and inhaled. Initially developed as a performance enhancer for athletes, SLAM targets the user's nervous system acting as a fear-inhibitor and painkiller. Once the severe physical side effects were discovered, the drug went underground and found popularity among mercs and outlaws who relied on it to provide that slight edge in combat. Unfortunately, SLAM is also heavily addictive, so many of these mercs ended up getting burned out on the drug. Heavy-duty SLAM junkies are easily identifiable in public; they have ‘the shakes’ -- involuntary muscle twitches. Important to note that this is not a sign of withdrawal, simply a side effect.

resources.name: Souvenirs
resources.description: Mementos purchased to commemorate visiting a location or attending an special event.

resources.name: Stims
resources.description: Composed of various combinations of tobacco, caffeine, and mood-enhancer, stims are smoked as a cigarette.

resources.name: Thermalfoam
resources.description: A light and flexible heat insulating foam. Must be stored under very high pressure to avoid it setting before application.

resources.name: Thrust
resources.description: This cocktail of chemicals provides the user with a massive boost of energy, increased sociability, euphoria, and heightened tactile sensitivity. Rumored to have been developed as an energy drink base, this drug has proven popular among those wishing for extra energy or to "party longer." However, owing to the risk of heart attack, deadly dehydration, and seizures, the mix has been banned in most areas. Users can be identified by their stuttering, rambling speech, flushed skin, and sweating.

resources.name: SlamUncut
resources.description: Initially developed for athletes before being outlawed, SLAM acts as a combat performance enhancer, targeting the user's nervous system as a fear-inhibitor and painkiller. Uncut SLAM is the concentrated form of the drug, and must be diluted to non-lethal dosages before it can be packaged into dispersal vials and consumed.

resources.name: Widow
resources.description: Thick, ink-black synthetic opioid commonly used as a recreational drug. WiDoW has spread like wildfire throughout the Empire thanks to the fact that it's relatively easy to produce. This also creates a wide variety of quality between batches of the drug. Designed to be injected as a liquid directly into the bloodstream, the name derived from one of the main side effects from extensive use, the drug stains the veins black, creating web-like subcutaneous patterns through the body. Illegal inside the UEE.

resources.name: HolidayLetter
resources.description: A gilded red envelope celebrating the Year of the Rat. Exchanging these envelopes is one of the most popular ways of celebrating Red Festival. Often the envelope may include a small amount of credits inside to help those you care about have a strong start in the upcoming cycle. Growing in popularity is the newer tradition of hiding the envelopes as a way of spreading good fortune and prosperity to those that fate has deemed in need.

resources.name: ProcyonCanister_Time
resources.description: This chemical is an industrial reactant that has found widespread use neutralizing irradiated materials. Because of how volatile it is, it must be kept in an electrically charged state or else a rapid exothermic reaction may occur before desired.

resources.name: Zip
resources.description: Zip is a hyper-accelerant that when added directly to the bloodstream, "supercharges" the user's nervous system causing sensory hallucinations such as colors become more vivid and hearing sounds that aren't there. These effects tend to make users seem to be in constant motion and easily distracted.

resources.name: CompBoard
resources.description: A main processing unit used inside various computers and electronics.

resources.name: Scrap
resources.description: Waste that is ready to be converted into new materials for reuse.

resources.name: Waste
resources.description: Unwanted and unusable materials that are designated to be discarded.

items.name: Procyon_canister_damage
items.description: This composite is a moldable material used in the construction of explosives. In addition to being commonly used in demolition applications for heavy industry and mining, it is also used to create small potent warheads. Care must be taken while transporting larger quantities of the composite as it is impact and heat sensitive.

items.name: Agricium
items.description: A rare and valuable silvery metal with a blue-green sheen. Malleable, ductile, and largely non-reactive.

items.name: agricium_ore
items.description: A rare and valuable silvery metal with a blue-green sheen. Malleable, ductile, and largely non-reactive.

items.name: agriculturalSupplies
items.description: Items required for agricultural production. Includes fertilizers, feed, and pesticides.

items.name: altruciatoxin
items.description: Created by chemically processing the pollen of Revenant Tree (altrucia lacus), common effects of ingesting or smoking altruciatoxin include relaxing of the muscles, sensory enhancement, and lethargy. Heavy usage can cause staining of the tongue.

items.name: aluminum
items.description: A chemically reactive, gray metal that is malleable, lightweight, ductile, strong, and resistant to corrosion. Capable of superconductivity.

items.name: aluminum_ore
items.description: A chemically reactive, gray metal that is malleable, lightweight, ductile, strong, and resistant to corrosion. Capable of superconductivity.

items.name: AmioshiPlague
items.description: Not nearly as ominous as its name, the Amioshi Plague is an invasive lichen that grows in the cracks of rocks. While the core of the lichen burrows out of sight to try and absorb as much moisture as it can find, the part near the surface sprouts hooded scales that eject spores to spread to other rocks. It's relatively short maturation period is the origin of its name.

items.name: aphorite
items.description: Decorative jewel crystal prized for its multi-hued tones.

items.name: argon
items.description: Chemically inert under most conditions, argon is an odorless, colorless gas that is as soluble in water as oxygen. Appears lilac in a discharge tube.

items.name: astatine
items.description: A dangerously radioactive, highly unstable halogen. Some of its isotopes have half-lives of one second or less.

items.name: atlasium
items.description: This very strong metal alloy is often one of the few materials salvageable from severe wreck sites.

items.name: ElectronicsEquipment
items.description: Devices, cabling, and rigging used for multimedia presentations and events.

items.name: beryl
items.description: A mineral that creates natural hexagonal crystals. Colorless in its pure form, its impure forms include the gems emerald and aquamarine.

items.name: raw_beryl
items.description: A mineral that creates natural hexagonal crystals. Colorless in its pure form, its impure forms include the gems emerald and aquamarine.

items.name: bexalite
items.description: This mineral harvested from worlds with no natural magnetic core, has found widespread use in electrical systems.

items.name: raw_bexalite
items.description: This mineral harvested from worlds with no natural magnetic core, has found widespread use in electrical systems.

items.name: bioplastic
items.description: A plastic replacement material created when fossil fuels began running low in Sol. It is derived from renewable biomass sources, often from vat grown bacteria but can be derived from industrial byproducts as well.

items.name: BlueBilva
items.description:
NDR: 23
HEI: 10
Effects: Hydrating, Energizing

The Blue Bilva is known for its distinctive rich flavor; which is highly astringent, aromatic and very high in fructose. The fruit can also be identified by its slightly pointed, ovoid shape, and dark blue to indigo skin. The fibrous flesh of the bilva clings firmly to its large stone which is so hard that it can only be cracked through mechanical means. It takes about 11 months to ripen on the tree. It is commonly eaten dried or turned into brandy.

items.name: borase
items.description: This highly thermally conductive material is often formed from cosmic ray spallation and is most typically found in younger star systems.

items.name: borase_ore
items.description: This highly thermally conductive material is often formed from cosmic ray spallation and is most typically found in younger star systems.

items.name: cadmiumallinide
items.description: This refined form of cadmium has great energy potential and is used frequently in reactors and batteries.

items.name: carbon
items.description: Owing to carbon's ability to form a variety of allotropes with vastly different properties and its sheer abundance in the universe, this element is used in a wide variety of applications.

items.name: carbonsilk
items.description: This light, flexible and incredibly strong material is woven from carbon strands collected from the secretions of specially bioengineered worms.

items.name: chlorine
items.description: A light gas with a high electron affinity and a yellow-green tone at room temperature. One of the halogens.

items.name: CK13-GIDSeedBlend
items.description: These genetically-modified barley seeds were banned because of their aggressive growth and high-levels of cross-pollination that has frequently ravaged any neighboring plant life. However, the plant's high yield and ease of growth have continued to make it a sought-after commodity.

items.name: CompBoard
items.description: A main processing unit used inside various computers and electronics.

items.name: ConstructionMaterials
items.description: Various supplies used to build, repair, and maintain buildings and structures.

items.name: copper
items.description: A soft red-orange colored metal with high conductivity. Prone to oxidation unless properly treated.

items.name: copper_ore
items.description: A soft red-orange colored metal with high conductivity. Prone to oxidation unless properly treated.

items.name: corundum
items.description: The crystalline form of aluminum oxide. Used as a gem. Varieties include ruby, sapphire, and padparadscha.

items.name: raw_corundum
items.description: The crystalline form of aluminum oxide. Used as a gem. Varieties include ruby, sapphire, and padparadscha.

items.name: DCSR2
items.description: An organically derived terpenoid lipid, dicylasterone (commonly known as DCSR2), has been banned from use in biomedical applications. Currently, it is most typically used in the manufacture of illegal narcotic 'SLAM.'

items.name: DecariPod
items.description: A large spore pod harvested from the decari that can be collected and used as a food source. However, the decari pod cannot be consumed directly. It must have its thick out layer and spiny filaments removed, and the fibrous hymenium cooked for a long time before it can be safely digested by Humans.

items.name: DegnousRoot
items.description: Degnous root is a macroalgae that was discovered in the shallow coastlines of Prime on Terra. Once harvested, degnous can be utilized as an ingredient in medical and health products thanks to its unique blend of amino acids.

items.name: diamond
items.description: An allotrope of the element carbon, diamonds form over billions of years under high heat and pressure. Extremely hard and thermally conductive.

items.name: diamondlaminate
items.description: One of the hardest manufactured materials today, this glass-like substance is frequently used in the construction of cockpit windows.

items.name: raw_diamond
items.description: An allotrope of the element carbon, diamonds form over billions of years under high heat and pressure. Extremely hard and thermally conductive.

items.name: Procyon_canister_quantum
items.description: An extremely heat resistant epoxy often used in the mounting and repair of ship thrusters. It is considered very difficult to transport in its uncured state as it becomes explosively unstable when exposed to Chan-Eisen fields during quantum travel. Specialized containers must be used to safely transport the epoxy long distances. Once set and cured, the Diluthermex is no longer reactive.

items.name: distilledSpirits
items.description: A purified beverage produced through the distillation of fermented substances. Possesses at least 20 percent of alcohol by volume.

items.name: dolivine
items.description: A dull green gemstone that is used decoratively but also can be used for industrial purposes thanks to its resistance to weathering and high density.

items.name: dopple
items.description: A dissociative drug that creates a strong feeling of separation. People, places, and objects familiar to the user take on a distorted and unreal quality. Some users report a detachment from emotions. Doplencyethorphine is used in small dosages medically to help with extreme emotion issues and rage management problems. Recreational users take it for the effect of resetting the mundane and everyday into something new and different. Side effects include memory loss, panic attacks, paranoia, and psychotic episodes.

items.name: dymantium
items.description: One of the toughest known metal alloys that can be forged. It is extremely difficult to manufacture and must be used with care in order to avoid accidentally weakening the material during application.

items.name: dynaflex
items.description: Developed for use by the military, this absorptive material can withstand severe stress owing to its flexibility.

items.name: elespo
items.description: A brand name of a light sponge-like material that has exceptional electrical absorption properties.

items.name: etam
items.description: Created from the leaves of indigenous plants, E'tam is an organic hallucinogenic drug used by the Xi'an to slow body function and focus in order to achieve a deeper meditative state. For Humans, the effects are much more severe. E'tam causes hyper awareness, cognitive enhancement and improved focus. Users can be so engrossed in tasks that they neglect to eat, sleep or take care of other body functions.

items.name: PartyFavors
items.description: Small items used to help encourage a festive mood. Typically given or sold to celebrants in attendance at an event or party.

items.name: fluorine
items.description: A toxic and highly reactive gas that appears pale yellow in its natural state. Very easily forms compounds with almost all other elements.

items.name: FotiaScrub
items.description: The fotia scrub relies on solar flares for its reproduction. Rather than having traditional stamen and pollen, it allows radiation from flares to mutate its genetics before releasing its seedpod. Some enterprising individuals seek out and collect the seedpods because of their natural radiological properties that can be utilized in various ways.

items.name: freeze
items.description: A synthetic tranquilizer used for muscle therapy that causes very heavy sedation in the user while also activating the nerve endings in their muscles. Originally created as a way to rebuild damaged/rebuilt muscle tissue, it found another use as a sedative weight-loss supplement, and when in a concentrated form, as a party drug.

items.name: GaspingWeevilEggs
items.description: The eggs of this small beetle are commonly held to be an aphrodisiac, but when allowed to hatch the weevils themselves will eat through sealants used in space station construction. Transport of the insect or its eggs is banned in the UEE.

items.name: glow
items.description: A variant of the street drug known as "Neon," Glow is formulated to create more euphoric feelings and less hallucinations than are normally associated with other members of its chemical family. The telltale sign of a user is that swallowing the capsule often leaves glowing residue on the tongue. Some people microdose Glow to help them maintain a more positive attitude (being careful to drip the dose directly onto the back of their throat). The main risk is that once the effect wears off people can become suicidally depressed for a short while before their brain chemistry normalizes.

items.name: gold
items.description: A commonly found ductile metal favored for its conductivity. Though it falls in and out of fashion, it is often used for decorative purposes as well.

items.name: GoldenMedmon
items.description:
NDR: 39
HEI: 19
Effects: Energizing, Hydrating

Grown in temperate climates on the Maru Ebony Tree, Golden Medmons are left to fall off the tree when ripe and collected. The fruit at that stage is extremely firm and astringent. They only become edible after being 'bletted' or softened through ethylene ripening.

items.name: gold_ore
items.description: A commonly found ductile metal favored for its conductivity. Though it falls in and out of fashion, it is often used for decorative purposes as well.

items.name: hadanite
items.description: A crystal oscillator sought out for its extremely high frequency of vibration which makes it useful in various applications.

items.name: HeartoftheWoods
items.description:
NDR: 31
Effects: Toxic

This fungus produces fleshy deep-red caps that grow in a pattern resembling a internal structure of a heart. Found in cold climates, it typically grows on trees and decaying logs. Not yet successfully cultivated commercially, this deep flavored mushroom is prized by epicureans across the 'verse and can fetch a high price in the right markets. It does contain a mild toxin that is destroyed when cooked, so consuming raw should be avoided.

items.name: helium
items.description: An inert noble gas that is colorless, tasteless, and non-toxic. The second most abundant element in the universe. Produced within stars during the nuclear fusion of hydrogen.

items.name: hephaestanite
items.description: Found often near volcanic outcroppings, this mineral is commonly used for a thermal insulator.

items.name: raw_hephaestanite
items.description: Found often near volcanic outcroppings, this mineral is commonly used for a thermal insulator.

items.name: hpmc
items.description: This liquid hexagonal lattice bonds readily to surfaces when electrically charged, solidifying almost instantaneously to create an incredibly strong and durable polymer mesh that maintains integrity at a range of temperatures and pressures.

items.name: HLX99Hyperprocessors
items.description: Commonly known as "Helixes" these Banu manufactured processing chips were designed for fullcore crypto-cracking and are used in the manufacture of computer system infiltration devices.

items.name: HumanFoodBars
items.description: Despite what the label on the packaging declares, the Banu manufactured "Human Food Bars" have been shown to contain multiple additives deemed unsafe for Human consumption.

items.name: hydrogen
items.description: The most abundant element in the universe. The building block of stars. Highly flammable in its pure form.

items.name: plasmaFuel
items.description: Hydrogen that is energized and then used by thrusters to propel vehicles.

items.name: inert_materials
items.description: Non-valuable materials collected during the mining process.

items.name: iodine
items.description: The heaviest stable halogen. Sublimes from a purple-black metallic solid into a violet gas.

items.name: JumpingLime
items.description:
NDR: 09
HEI: 06
Effects: Dehydrating

Grows on a cactus in the deserts of Yar (Centauri II). A local variant that developed naturally after terraformation was complete, the spiny fruit start off purple and turn green when they are ripe.

They acquired their name because of the ease in which they fall off the cactus and attach themselves to clothing and skin, as if they "jumped" there.

The leathery, barbed skin must be peeled back to reveal the juicy flesh of the interior. The taste is sweet, extremely tart and astringent.

Locals warn that if you become lost in the dessert you should be careful using jumping limes for hydration as they can make you feel even more thirsty.

items.name: laranite
items.description: A somewhat radioactive, crystalline gemstone. Black with streaks of dark red, it can only be used as jewelry if shielded.

items.name: raw_laranite
items.description: A somewhat radioactive, crystalline gemstone. Black with streaks of dark red, it can only be used as jewelry if shielded.

items.name: lastaprene
items.description: An advanced synthetic polymer designed with optimal properties for several commercial applications. It has greater viscoelasticity than most commonly produced rubbers.

items.name: Special_HolidayBox
items.type: A small, wrapped package meant to get you in the Luminalia spirit. Banu merchants celebrating the holiday used to hide small gifts aboard their ship to encourage revelers to explore all their wares. As the holiday grew in popularity within the UEE, Human merchants modified this tradition by hiding empty gift-wrapped packages around a space station or landing zone that could be exchanged for credits if returned unopened. The increased foot traffic into their stores spurned holiday sales and became a tradition in its own right. \n\nStow this gift for sentimental value, or sell it at a commodities terminal and spend the credits on a holiday gift for yourself.

items.name: Spiral
items.description:
NDR: 23
HEI: 10
Effects: Hydrating

The Lunes is a deciduous tree native to the warmer areas of Osha in Kilian system. It bears an edible fruit known as a Lunes fruit or a Spiral Fruit based on the circular ridges that can form once the fruit begins to ripen. The fruit’s skin is covered with a short fuzz that is generally removed before consumption. When ripe, the Lunes is a very sweet and juicy flavor and have become a very popular summer delicacy, commonly found in ice cream and other desserts.

items.name: medicalSupplies
items.description: A variety of items produced primarily to treat injury or illness.

items.name: medicalSupplies_medPens
items.description: The use of these imitation CureLife Medpens has resulted in numerous deaths.

items.name: mixedMining
items.description: A mixed collection of commodities obtained by mining

items.name: mobyGlassPersonalComputers
items.description: These knock-off mobiGlas use pirated software and are often infected with spyware and malicious programming.

items.name: neograph
items.description: A recently discovered form of graphene, this complicated lattice structure of carbon molecules produces an extremely light and strong material.

items.name: neon
items.description: A psychoactive designer drug known for increased energy, euphoria, and mild hallucinations (particularly how the body processes light). Due to its chemical complexity, it's much more expensive than other street drugs, but is very popular in club culture.

items.name: nitrogen
items.description: A low-density, diatomic gas with no color or odor in its natural state. A necessary element in human respiration.

items.name: omnapoxy
items.description: Durable and resistant, this resin quickly sets when applied to form a hardened polymer.

items.name: OsoianHides
items.description: The tanned skins from Osoians, a Fair Chance protected species from Oso II.

items.name: medicalSupplies_oxyPens
items.description: The third most abundant element in the universe, oxygen is a highly reactive chalcogen gas that readily forms oxides with other materials.

items.name: Oza
items.description:
NDR: 09
HEI: 07
Effects: Hydrating

A hybrid citrus first grown in Croshaw, it's hardiness, ease of transport, and juice yield has seen it rapidly spread across the Empire. It features thick, bumpy dark green skin, bright orange flesh ribbed with heavy pithing, and no seeds. 

Tart, sweet and bitter, the taste of Oza often described as being a combination of all the other citrus types rolled into one fruit. Difficult to peel and fibrous, its pulp is not often eaten. Typically it is split open and sucked on, its flesh being discarded. It is also popularly used in many cocktail recipes.

items.name: Pingala
items.description: Every aspect of the pingala follows the golden ratio resulting a visually arresting plant. This include its seeds which are highly sought after by plant collectors. Especially since attempts to cultivate the pingala in greenhouse environments has proven extremely difficult.

items.name: Pitambu
items.description:
NDR: 25
HEI: 10
Effects: Hydrating, Hypo-Metabolic, Immune Boosting

The skin of the pitambu is thin and waxy and easily peeled away using its green leaf-like growths. Inside is a is crisp and watery, bright red flesh which is filled with tiny white seeds that have a mild, nutty taste. The flesh and seeds are traditionally consumed together.

items.name: processedFood
items.description: A nutritional substance that has been transformed trough physical or chemical means into food.

items.name: Prota
items.description: A resilient slime mold that can form in extremely corrosive environments and pressure, Prota secretes a strong adhesive that can be distilled into a commercial-grade glue.

items.name: quantanium
items.description: A highly unstable mineral used in the production of quantum fuel.

items.name: raw_quantainium
items.description: A highly unstable mineral used in the production of quantum fuel.

items.name: quantumFuel
items.description: Fuel used by quantum drives to propel ships at high speeds or, if equipped with a jump module, through jump tunnels to other systems.

items.name: quartz
items.description: A chiral crystal composed of silicon and oxygen that can be found in a wide variety of forms and colors.

items.name: raw_quartz
items.description: A chiral crystal composed of silicon and oxygen that can be found in a wide variety of forms and colors.

items.name: RantaDung
items.description: A dry cube-shaped dung that comes from a large isopod-like crustacean known as a Ranta. It has recently been discovered that the dung contains a unique bacterial biome that helps the Ranta process and digest minerals and some researches are hopeful will lead to industrial or medical innovations.

items.name: rmc
items.description: Recycled Material Composite, commonly referred to as RMC, is the end result of low-tier salvaging where a myriad of alloys and polymers are mixed together during the collection process.

items.name: RedfinEnergyModulator
items.description: Made by various Banu manufacturers, this energy modulator is distinct for its red-hued heatsinks. Though it can be installed into most Human component subsystems to reduce power draw, its extremely dangerous fail rate has caused it to be banned for import into the UEE.

items.name: LifeCureMedsticks
items.description: The use of these imitation CureLife Medpens has resulted in numerous deaths.

items.name: RevenantPod
items.description: Contrary to its ominous name, the Revenant is actually a variety of the Altrucia Tree, an indigenous plant of Terra known for its thick and colorful leaves. Geoengineers introduced fields of Altrucias to Hyperion in an effort to break up the dust storms. Although the project failed, the Altrucia trees adapted to the perpetual wind patterns, shedding its leaves and thickening the wood in the trunk. Botanists initially believed that the Altrucias had died, but on closer inspection, discovered that they were quite alive and thus, the name was born.The pods are collected because the pollen is processed and turned into Altruciatoxin.

items.name: altruciatoxin_unprocessed
items.description: The pollen of Revenant Tree (altrucia lacus).

items.name: RS1OdyseySpacesuits
items.description: These imitation RSI Odyssey undersuits are cheaply made counterfeits that are hazardous to use.

items.name: sarilus
items.description: A material first introduced into Human manufacturing after trade with the Banu. It is extremely distortion resistant. Though Human made Sarilus does a good job, many hold that the Banu manufactured product is superior.

items.name: scrap
items.description: Waste that is ready to be converted into new materials for reuse.

items.name: ShipAmmunition
items.description: Refill your ship's ballistic ammunition.

items.name: silicon
items.description: A strong and brittle element with good thermal conductivity. Crystalizes in a diamond form.

items.name: silnex
items.description: An advanced silica ceramic developed by early RSI researchers to allow ships to better withstand atmospheric reentry.

items.name: slam
items.description: Most commonly ingested as a gas. Vials of SLAM are cracked and inhaled. Initially developed as a performance enhancer for athletes, SLAM targets the user's nervous system acting as a fear-inhibitor and painkiller. Once the severe physical side effects were discovered, the drug went underground and found popularity among mercs and outlaws who relied on it to provide that slight edge in combat. Unfortunately, SLAM is also heavily addictive, so many of these mercs ended up getting burned out on the drug. Heavy-duty SLAM junkies are easily identifiable in public; they have ‘the shakes’ -- involuntary muscle twitches. Important to note that this is not a sign of withdrawal, simply a side effect.

items.name: Souvenirs
items.description: Mementos purchased to commemorate visiting a location or attending an special event.

items.name: steel
items.description: An alloy of iron and carbon, this ancient material is still in uses thanks to its affordable price and high tensile strength.

items.name: stims
items.description: Composed of various combinations of tobacco, caffeine, and mood-enhancer, stims are smoked as a cigarette.

items.name: SunsetBerry
items.description:
NDR: 08
HEI: 06
Effect: Toxic

These sunset-hued berries grow best in cold climates. They are toxic and not suitable for Human consumption. Eating them can result in symptoms such as vomiting and extreme cramping. Higher dosages have been known to be fatal. While the raw unprocessed berries are very bitter and tannic, once fermented, the resulting poisonous brew has a very sweet taste and is more commonly known as "Death Wine." Recently, medical researchers are investigating if the toxin in sunset berries could be used to help treat nerve damage or neurological diseases.

items.name: taranite
items.description: Extremely conductive, this mineral was first discovered when a researcher noticed a breed of electrosensitive hermit crab using pieces of it to form its shell.

items.name: raw_taranite
items.description: Extremely conductive, this mineral was first discovered when a researcher noticed a breed of electrosensitive hermit crab using pieces of it to form its shell.

items.name: thermalfoam
items.description: A light and flexible heat insulating foam. Must be stored under very high pressure to avoid it setting before application.

items.name: thrust
items.description: This cocktail of chemicals provides the user with a massive boost of energy, increased sociability, euphoria, and heightened tactile sensitivity. Rumored to have been developed as an energy drink base, this drug has proven popular among those wishing for extra energy or to "party longer." However, owing to the risk of heart attack, deadly dehydration, and seizures, the mix has been banned in most areas. Users can be identified by their stuttering, rambling speech, flushed skin, and sweating.

items.name: titanium
items.description: This silver-colored chemical element is excellent at producing strong, lightweight alloys.

items.name: titanium_ore
items.description: This silver-colored chemical element is excellent at producing strong, lightweight alloys.

items.name: tungsten
items.description: Used in many different alloys, tungsten in its pure form becomes malleable while maintaining its hardness.

items.name: tungsten_ore
items.description: Used in many different alloys, tungsten in its pure form becomes malleable while maintaining its hardness.

items.name: waste
items.description: Unwanted and unusable materials that are designated to be discarded.

items.name: widow
items.description: Thick, ink-black synthetic opioid commonly used as a recreational drug. WiDoW has spread like wildfire throughout the Empire thanks to the fact that it's relatively easy to produce. This also creates a wide variety of quality between batches of the drug. Designed to be injected as a liquid directly into the bloodstream, the name derived from one of the main side effects from extensive use, the drug stains the veins black, creating web-like subcutaneous patterns through the body. Illegal inside the UEE.

items.name: xapyen
items.description: Only recently used in Human manufacturing, this complex alloy of Xi'an origin is a jack of all trades that is extremely useful in numerous applications.

items.name: Special_HolidayLetter
items.type: A gilded red envelope celebrating the Year of the Dog. Exchanging these envelopes is one of the most popular ways of celebrating Red Festival. Often the envelope may include a small amount of credits inside to help those you care about have a strong start in the upcoming cycle. Growing in popularity is the newer tradition of hiding the envelopes as a way of spreading good fortune and prosperity to those that fate has deemed in need.

items.name: Procyon_canister_time
items.description: This chemical is an industrial reactant that has found widespread use neutralizing irradiated materials. Because of how volatile it is, it must be kept in an electrically charged state or else a rapid exothermic reaction may occur before desired.

items.name: zip
items.description: Zip is a hyper-accelerant that when added directly to the bloodstream, "supercharges" the user's nervous system causing sensory hallucinations such as colors become more vivid and hearing sounds that aren't there. These effects tend to make users seem to be in constant motion and easily distracted.
